notes.title: "Cosmo Dreamer" Ver. 2.22 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Cosmo Dreamer.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 2.22 update of Cosmo Dreamer.

In this version, we have made the following changes.

・Added a specification that a demo play is played after a certain amount of time on the title screen.
　The opening and some demo plays are repeated after each playback.
・Added "STEAM DECK" button type to key configurations.
　Caution! After the update, the game may load with different settings than before.
・Long pressing the directional buttons will now automatically send items.
・Added a screen to confirm whether to send scores to the online ranking when a specific game mode is completed.
・Changed the selection method of ranking.
・When changing the language of configuration, language data is loaded when the screen is switched.
・Fixed a problem that the game speed may become unstable at the start of a game.
・Fixed a problem that the language name on the option screen is not displayed.
・Fixed some other problems.

notes.title: CosmoDreamer Ver. 2.10 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Cosmo Dreamer.

We have just released Ver2.10 update mainly adding "Steam Achievements", "Ranking" and "Practice Mode".
The Ver2.10BETA version that was recently released to the public is no longer available.
Thank you for participating in the beta test.


The following changes have been made in this version.

Support for SteamAPI
Support for Steam Achievements
Addition of a "Ranking" screen.
Added a process to send results to the leaderboard on the results screen after completing trials and extras.
Added Practice Mode (Practice mode is available after clearing Stage 1)
(Practice mode is unlocked after clearing stage 1)
Added "Button Type" and "Keyboard Config" to Key Configuration.
New key prompts for each game screen.
Changed the graphics of the startup screen.
Revised some parts of the manual.
The ending credits have been reorganized.
Changed so that all difficulties up to Expert are unlocked from the initial state.
Changed so that players can select Counter Mode in Trial Mode after unlocking Counter Mode.
Changed some conditions for unlocking hidden elements.
(To unlock Nightmare difficulty, players must now "clear up to stage 8 as an expert" and "clear the trial as an expert.)
Lighter graphics output processing.
Fixed some other bugs.

Acquired achievements are sent to the Steam server upon startup.
Unlike Like Dreamer, Cosmo Dreamer cannot save replays of practice mode.

notes.title: CosmoDream Ver2.00 update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38756894/5fbd10ba1b55ab9c3675a39f8161b2d8b54f6d8f.png[/img]

We are pleased to announce that we have updated "CosmoDreamer" to Ver. 2.00.

Contents of the update of ver 2.00

1.Extra stages have been implemented.
　Extra stages can be selected from the same stage select screen after clearing Trial Mode.
　You cannot select the difficulty level in this stage.

2.Added new illustrations to the gallery.

3.A 1UP item has been added to Stage 8 of Main Mode.

4.The invincibility time after being hit has been adjusted.

5.Fixed the processing when the score reaches 1 trillion points.

6.Added characters that can be used in the score name when saving a replay.

7.Fixed a bug in which the number of times played was counted when replaying a game.

8.Replays saved in versions prior to 1.01 cannot be replayed in this version or later.
　We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Announcement of "CosmoDreamer" ver. 2.00 update coming soon
notes.content:
We will be updating the new version of CosmoDreamer, ver2.00, soon.
In this update, we plan to add extra stages and adjust some specifications.

For the sake of reproducibility
You will no longer be able to replay replays saved in the previous version.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but if you have important replay data
If you have important replay data, we recommend that you save it separately by recording video or other means.
Thank you for your understanding.
